# Scribe 0.5.1
- Restores interrupted recordings to Recovery when their `session.json` metadata is missing or unreadable but the preserved audio folder still exists. - Reconnects recovery records whose saved staging path no longer matches the current Mac. - Replaces the misleading missing-`session.json` filesystem error with the exact unavailable recording-folder location, without deleting the recovery record.

# Scribe 0.5.0
- Refocuses Scribe on its core lesson-recording, local transcription, library, and real-time assistant experience. - Removes the coaching workspace, Student Practice, pre-lesson briefs, the accuracy-check flow, and all feedback calibration gates. - Leaves existing `TeacherCoaching`, `TeacherLearningData`, and `StudentPractice` data on disk. Scribe no longer reads or changes that data, so it remains inert.

# Scribe 0.4.6
- Adds an opt-in teacher coaching workspace with concise post-lesson debrief cards, self-reflection, a single active teaching focus, and transparent OpenAI usage and cost controls. - Adds “Explain this” help throughout recording, queue, library, people, transcript, and settings screens. - Improves transcript readability and performance while preserving every word and timestamp returned by CrisperWhisper's native decoder. - Makes completed transcriptions and coaching debriefs easier to notice and open from notifications and the queue.

# Scribe 0.4.5
- Keeps recording the selected microphone automatically when Zoom changes macOS audio routes while screen sharing with sound starts or stops. - Avoids unnecessary microphone restarts when audio buffers are still arriving normally. - Preserves synchronization between microphone and lesson-audio tracks when recovery is genuinely required.

# Scribe 0.4.4
- Adds Apple Speech as an on-device live transcription option for Teacher Assistant while keeping completed-lesson transcription unchanged. - Adds optional experimental speaker echo reduction to saved recording setups and strengthens microphone recovery when audio devices change during a lesson. - Stops transcript audio as soon as you leave Transcriptions, remembers each lesson's position in memory, and prevents multiple lessons from playing at once. - Fixes Edited and Unedited filtering, queue pausing, safe transcript export, import cancellation, prepared lesson-focus invalidation, paired-device removal, and duplicate speaker-identity submissions. - Improves transcription ETA reporting and cold-start benchmarking, blocks recording until local transcription is ready, and gives interrupted recordings clearer keep-or-delete recovery choices. - Refreshes the installer disk image with a verified drag-to-Applications layout and stronger release auditing.
